lots_type_consistency_chk.name: lots_type_consistency_chk
lots_type_consistency_chk.value:
(("inventory"."lots"."lot_type" = 'finished_good' AND "inventory"."lots"."product_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory"."lots"."raw_material_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("inventory"."lots"."lot_type" = 'raw_material' AND "inventory"."lots"."raw_material_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory"."lots"."product_id" IS NULL))

lots_expiry_chk.name: lots_expiry_chk
lots_expiry_chk.value: "inventory"."lots"."expires_on" IS NULL OR "inventory"."lots"."manufactured_on" IS NULL OR "inventory"."lots"."expires_on" >= "inventory"."lots"."manufactured_on"
